t: India waived its 11% cotton import duty from June 1 to October 31, 2026, and is expected to extend it to December 31 (industry and government sources, Oct 26-27; not yet notified). Trade estimates put India's 2026/27 crop at about 29m Indian bales, down 12-18% from about 33m — roughly 22.6m 480-lb bales vs USDA's 24.0m. USDA has India's imports at 3.3m bales vs 5.2m last season, so a smaller crop with duty-free access is upside for import demand, including US cotton.
